notes.title: AngelPixel Studios: Next Fest 2024
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

As Steam Next Fest is coming up in February 2024, we wanted to go live and online for you all to watch us, the devs, play Arcane Arena and get the chance to chat with us and ask questions.

Also, as a part of Next Fest 2024, you'll be able to get a chance to try out Arcane Arena on two different dates while we are live. We will be doing multiple key drops throughout the live stream, giving everyone a chance to play. 

We will be live streaming this event on the following dates:


Saturday, February 3rd 2024 @ 13:30 PM PT
Sunday, February 4th 2024 @ 13:30 PM PT


Don't forget to wishlist Arcane Arena on Steam to become one of the first to play!
Wishlist Here

To make sure you don't miss out on any of the action, make sure you're up to date with us by following us on:


YouTube
X
Twitch
and our Discord Community Server!


- AngelPixel Studios

notes.title: Arcane Arena - Announcement Trailer
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

We've got some exciting news to share today here at AngelPixel.

Today, we've released the first teaser trailer for Arcane Arena!
This is so exciting for us, as we absolutely cannot wait to show you what we've been working on, and we can't wait to see what you all think!

While you wait for us, please consider joining our Discord community for updates, screenshots and more!

Here's the trailer:

Watch it here!

We deeply appreciate all of you being so patient with us while we bring our game to it's full potential, and if you haven't already, make sure to wishlist Arcane Arena on the Steam marketplace, to be the first to play on release day.

Thank you all so much for your continued support, we have more updates lined up, so stay tuned!

- AngelPixel
